prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s city street: wet cobbles, an iron street lamp, a small bakery with a lit cream shop window full of loaves and a plain sign with no lettering, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. Close in the crush of two shoving crowds under the street lamp: shoulder to shoulder and nose to nose, large in frame, a broad young white docker in overalls with a red scarf and a broken front tooth, and a tall middle-aged Black woman in a factory smock with a blue scarf and grey in her hair, both mid-shove, both shouting, real-skinned faces wet with rain and sweat. Behind them, more red and blue scarves and plain banners with no writing in a blur of bodies, both crowds young and old, Black, white and South Asian. The street lamp above lights them hard from the top; the bakery's warm window glows behind. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the lamp on their faces and the wet cobbles. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
